race.comment: KIEFFER (4) could be value here. Has been racing in Darwin but returns home and looks well placed. Easier race and looks hard to hold out. THE BIG FREEZE (2) was prominent at the turn and ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1400m at this track after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Racing well and will take running down. BRAZEN SAILOR (3) settled well back last time out then found the line strongly to finish 5.5 lengths away in fourth over 1300m at Katherine. Long overdue and among the leading chances. HIGHSTRUNG (1) led throughout last start to score an effortless 4-length win over 1200m at this track. More weight but going well and will take catching again. LOVE TO LIE (6) is next best.
